description: Every morning: a check on any trip in the next week, with times, documents, weather and a packing list.
instructions_md: Look for trips starting in the next seven days, in my calendar, booking emails (if mail is connected) and what's in memory. For each trip: departure times and how long before to leave for the airport or station, when check-in opens, the bookings I have and any I seem to be missing, documents I need (passport, visa, tickets), the weather at the destination and a packing list for it. Mention anything that needs doing today. Don't book, change or cancel anything. If no trip is coming up, reply in one short line.
